notes.title: Update 0.13d
notes.content: -Fixed a bug where a personal new record wasn't updating correctly on the leaderboard

notes.title: Update 0.13b
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where pressing "stop" button right after "step" button would cause the "play" button to not execute the code anymore
-Fixed a bug where user-defined functions were not cleared from cache when the code stopped executing

notes.title: Update 0.13a
notes.content:
-Added [b]Forum[/b] button in the main scene that links to the discussion section of steam where you can report bugs, discuss code, give feedback and suggestions etc...
-Added [b]Discord[/b] button
-Added [b]Review[/b] button available after solving the forth puzzle, it leads to a little puzzle. Solving the puzzle opens the steam page of the game where you can leave a review. This is of course optional, if you don't want to review just skip the puzzle ;)

notes.title: Update 0.13
notes.content:
-Fixed a bug where solving a puzzle on Tab2 where automatically setting Tab1 as default and miscalculating scores
-The leaderboard scores will not be reset right now, but when a big update with new puzzles is released

notes.title: Update v0.12
notes.content: -Fixed a bug where multiple function calls could be executed on the same line

notes.title: Update v0.11
notes.content:
-Added the button "[b]Hint[/b]"
-Added hints for the[b] first puzzles[/b] either to help players with no coding knowledge, or to make instructions clearer if misleading.
-More hints for the harder puzzles will come later.

notes.title: Update v0.1
notes.content: -Fixed a bug where the iterations weren't counting correctly in the Bishop scene puzzle
